title: Topic 16
japanese_text: 近所の旅館は、とても人気で客が絶えない。人気の理由の一つは、各部屋に<u>備え付けられ</u>ている露天風呂だ。宿泊客は露天風呂に<u>浸かり</u>ながら、<u>情緒</u>ある古い建物や美しい景色を楽しめる。そして<u>何より</u>有名なのが料理だ。地元の<u>名産</u>品をたっぷり使った料理は大人気で、三つ星にも<u>認定され</u>ている。我が町が<u>誇る</u>施設の一つである。
english_translation: A traditional ryokan near me is very popular and is constantly packed with guests. One reason for this popularity is the open-air baths provided in each room. Guests can soak in the open-air baths and enjoy the elegant atmosphere of the old buildings and beautiful scenery. More than anything, the hotel is famous for its cuisine. The cuisine, which uses many local specialties, is immensely popular and has been recognized with three stars. It is one of the things our town takes the most pride in.
